annotations.title: Find models that fit a budget or need

description: Filter currently priced models by maximum input or output price (USD per 1M tokens), minimum context window, minimum output tokens, provider, or a Kingy home-hardware verdict, sorted by price or context. Facts only: it does not rank quality.

include_automated_parse.description: Include extended providers parsed automatically. Default true.

min_context_window.description: Smallest acceptable context window in tokens.

min_output_tokens.description: Smallest acceptable maximum output per request.

must_run_on.description: Only models with a Kingy "Yes" or "Yes, but slow" verdict for this machine type.

name: find_models_that_fit
title: Find models that fit a budget or need
